plain: Ever since the first atomic bombs of 1945, UFOs have taken a huge interest in nuclear weapons and have quietly disabled them so they will not go off, according to Joe McMoneagle, a remote viewer, someone who says he can perceive distant things with his mind. He tells Michels that the last missile Russian President Vladimir Putin tried to launch as a test blew up in its silo. If true, it would mean someone outside humanity is keeping nuclear weapons in check.
